info.title: Wazabiashara API
info.description:
Multi-tenant SaaS API for small businesses.

**Auth**: Bearer token from `POST /api/auth/sign-in/email`.
**Business scope**: `x-business-id` header or `{businessId}` path param.
**Envelope**: `{success, data, message, request_id}`.
**Error codes**: AUTH_REQUIRED, FORBIDDEN, VALIDATION_ERROR, MODULE_NOT_AVAILABLE, PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED, SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED, RATE_LIMITED, SERVER_ERROR.

200.description: Returns user + session — use token as Bearer

get.summary: Generate PDF receipt → file meta (download via /files/:fileId)
